origin: SI-authored synthetic correction pairs created for the shared evaluation registry. Explicit fixed dev/test assignments; no private text, external benchmark, automatic corruption or training data used.
scope: Noisy Pinyin to Hanzi, Chinese character corrections, English spelling, mixed technical names and exact-preservation controls. These are requested transformations, not a claim that automatic correction is always appropriate.
training_overlap: Not audited against any training corpus; not an independent production benchmark.
